construction.implementation_origin: Original implementation authored in the isolated build directory.

input.customer: id required; name, interests, nonnegative budget optional; omitted budget means unconstrained
input.query: string; blank query falls back to interests, then browsing
input.catalog: up to 1000 unique products: id, title, description, category, price, currency, tags
input.research: question and up to 500 sources with id, title, text, product_ids and reliability in [0,1]
input.limits: optional search, recommendations and evidence integer limits in [1,50]

shared_schema.output: status, schema_version, stage, normalized request and accumulated onboarding/search/recommendations/research payloads
shared_schema.validation: Shared validate_request and validate_state gates enforce every handoff, stage order, identity, candidate membership, budget, exact citations and coverage consistency.
shared_schema.errors: Validation, decoding and file errors print a single JSON object with status error and exit 2; success prints a single JSON object and exits 0.
shared_schema.currency: Single caller-supplied catalog currency; budget is denominated in that currency. No conversion.

cross_stage_handoffs.consumed: Validated effective query, explicit interests and budget.
Validated budget-eligible search candidate identifiers and relevance scores; retained onboarding preferences.
Validated ordered shortlist; only supplied sources linked to shortlisted products may produce evidence.

behavior.onboarding: Personalized greeting, missing preference detection, clear next action, interest-based query fallback.
behavior.search: Unicode normalization, small explicit synonym dictionary, conservative deterministic typo correction, weighted token overlap, budget filtering, stable identifier tie-break.
behavior.recommendations: Search score plus four points per declared-interest match plus fractional affordability; one-point repeated-category diversity penalty, floored at zero. No implicit sensitive profiling.
behavior.research: Extract verbatim question-relevant sentences, rank supplied evidence by caller reliability and overlap, cite source IDs, report coverage gaps. Select the highest-ranked covered recommendation for review, not as factual endorsement.
behavior.empty_results: No search candidates produces no recommendations and no_candidates research decision; missing relevant sources produces insufficient_evidence.
behavior.determinism: No randomness, clocks, external calls or LLMs; deterministic tie breaks; inputs are not mutated.
behavior.fixtures: All example customer, catalog, source and claim data are explicitly synthetic.

included: General-purpose explicit-preference onboarding, lexical discovery and extractive evidence
excluded: Networks, live providers and model calls
Semantic embeddings or universal intent understanding
Independent source authentication or automatic factual contradiction resolution
Purchases, account persistence, authentication and production service infrastructure

test_outcomes.coverage: All four stages, all handoffs, personalized ranking, synonyms, typos, exact citations, deterministic nonmutation, empty and invalid input, tampering, limits and real CLI subprocess behavior.
